item.title: Integrated Commercial Hotels Program
item.description:
Homeless Services | Procurement | Award | $70.2M | Vendor: Volunteers of America Greater New York Inc | Flagged: Contract value ≥ $1M

The Department of Homeless Services  is seeking appropriately qualified contractors/vendors to contract for the provision of shelter services for families with children, adult families, and single adults who are temporarily housed in DHS contracted commercial hotels. The selected vendors will provide services as outlined in this RFP to assist clients with their daily needs and to help them move out of the shelter system as quickly as possible.

The mission of DHS is to prevent homelessness when possible and to provide short-term emergency shelter for individuals and families who have no other housing options available. DHS primarily meets this goal by providing services to clients in long-term contracted purpose-built shelters throughout the City. When there are not enough available shelter beds and units in traditional shelters, DHS temporarily uses commercial hotels to house clients while they transition to permanent housing.  

Over the last 15 years, DHS has faced numerous crises which have forced DHS to rely on commercial hotels to temporarily house clients. Long term DHS is committed to phasing out the use of commercial hotels.

item.title: Defensive Driving Services
item.description:
Citywide Administrative Services | Procurement | Award | $375K | Vendor: National Traffic Safety Institute Corporation | Flagged: Sole-source / non-competitive

DCAS is requesting to extend the contract for 18 months from February 28, 2026, to August 27, 2027 to continue defensive driving services with National Traffic Safety Institute Corporation (NTSI) through the Negotiated Acquisition Extension procurement method pursuant to §3-04(b)(2)(iii) of the Procurement Policy Board Rules.

The cost of this NAE will be $375,000.00. This extension is needed while DCAS works on an RFP for a new contract. DCAS is currently in the evaluation process to award a vendor.

The term of the original contract was March 1, 2017, through February 28, 2020.

DCAS renewed the contract CT1856 20205401621 for a period of 3 years term from February 29, 2020 through February 27, 2023.

DCAS has exercised the 1-year ACCO extension, from February 28, 2023 through February 27, 2024. DCAS has exercised the first NAE(CT120248806088) from February 28, 2024 through February 27, 2025.

DCAS has exercised the second NAE (CTI 20258807034) from February 28, 2025 through February 27, 2026 and will be utilizing a third NAE.

item.title: SMD_A&CM_RFQ #518124 - Elevator Rehabilitation at Marcy Houses
item.description:
Housing Authority | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-08-27 | Flagged: Key-agency activity

The Work under this Contract (RFQ No. 518124  Elevator Package) consists of the rehabilitation, modernization, maintenance, and service of seventy (70) elevators across twenty-seven (27) residential buildings at Marcy Houses. The Contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, supervision, and incidental services necessary to complete the Work in accordance with the Contract Documents.

The scope includes, but is not limited to, the removal and replacement of existing elevator systems and the furnishing and installation of new elevator equipment, including machines, controls, hoistway components, car enclosures, doors, communication systems, safety devices, and associated electrical components. The Work also includes testing, inspection, commissioning, training, and coordination with NYCHA and other trades, including a separate electrical contract.
